recommendations.title: Install Better Block Entities
recommendations.reason: Draws chests, signs, beds and similar blocks much more cheaply, which helps a lot in storage rooms and large bases.

recommendations.title: Install C2ME
recommendations.reason: Generates and loads chunks on several CPU cores at once, so new terrain appears faster while you explore. RigTune doesn't also offer Fast Noise or Material Rule Compiler, which conflict with it. (alpha build)

recommendations.title: Install Dynamic FPS
recommendations.reason: Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps.

recommendations.title: Install Entity Culling
recommendations.reason: Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms.

recommendations.title: Install FerriteCore
recommendations.reason: Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory.

recommendations.title: Install ImmediatelyFast
recommendations.reason: Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags.

recommendations.title: Install Lithium
recommendations.reason: Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick.

recommendations.title: Install ModernFix-mVUS
recommendations.reason: Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them.

recommendations.title: Install More Culling
recommendations.reason: Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip.

recommendations.title: Install ScalableLux
recommendations.reason: A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build)

recommendations.title: Install Async Logger
recommendations.reason: Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O.

recommendations.title: Install BadOptimizations
recommendations.reason: A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked.

recommendations.title: Install Debugify
recommendations.reason: Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked.

recommendations.title: Install FastQuit
recommendations.reason: Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background.

recommendations.title: Install Ixeris
recommendations.reason: Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller.

recommendations.title: Install Krypton
recommendations.reason: Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers.

recommendations.title: Install Sodium Extra
recommendations.reason: Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS.

recommendations.title: Install Structure Layout Optimizer
recommendations.reason: Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server.

recommendations.title: Max Framerate: 120 → 170
recommendations.reason: Avoids rendering frames your monitor can't show; with FreeSync or G-Sync it also keeps the frame rate inside the variable-refresh range.

recommendations.title: Render Distance: 4 → 6
recommendations.reason: Your hardware can handle 12 chunks smoothly; the benchmark can fine-tune it. The server sends at most 6 chunks.

recommendations.title: VSync: On → Off
recommendations.reason: Optional: turning VSync off lowers input lag but can cause tearing; leave it on if you see tearing.

recommendations.title: AMD driver issue handled by Sodium
recommendations.reason: Your AMD driver applies a Minecraft-specific tweak that can make terrain invisible. Sodium hides the game from that driver check automatically, so you don't need to do anything.
